ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the contents of the two attached figures are the same; both are plane rectangular coordinate systems, and the gray shaded region is a triangle, located on the right side of the y-axis, mainly at the position x>0. The three boundary lines are marked in the figure as 2x-y-2=0, x+2y-1=0, and 3x+y-8=0. The origin O is on the left side of the shaded region. In the figure, two dashed lines are drawn from O, among which the lower one points to the lower-right vertex A. Then reason: the problem statement gives that M is in the closed triangular region represented by the system of inequalities 2x-y-2≥0, x+2y-1≥0, 3x+y-8≤0. Find the three vertices: solving 2x-y-2=0 and x+2y-1=0 simultaneously gives (1,0), and at this time the slope of OM is 0; solving 2x-y-2=0 and 3x+y-8=0 simultaneously gives (2,2), and the slope is 2/2=1; solving x+2y-1=0 and 3x+y-8=0 simultaneously gives (3,-1), and the slope is -1/3. Since the entire feasible triangle is on the x>0 side, the minimum value of the slope y/x of the line OM corresponds to the boundary position where the ray rotating from O is tangent to the region, so the vertex slopes can be compared. The smallest among the three is -1/3.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：坐标系中阴影区域是一个三角形，边界分别标成 2x-y-2=0、x+2y-1=0、3x+y-8=0，原点 O 在区域左侧，图中从 O 作出的较低虚线指向右下顶点 A。再由题干读取三条不等式，确认 M 在这三条直线围成的闭三角形内。求三角形三个顶点：2x-y-2=0 与 x+2y-1=0 交于 (1,0)，斜率 0；2x-y-2=0 与 3x+y-8=0 交于 (2,2)，斜率 1；x+2y-1=0 与 3x+y-8=0 交于 (3,-1)，斜率 -1/3。因为图中整个可行三角形位于 x>0 一侧，直线 OM 的斜率 y/x 在凸多边形上的最小值会出现在边界顶点，也可理解为从 O 旋转射线与区域相切时取得极值。比较三个顶点斜率，最小为 -1/3。

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：阴影区域在 y 轴右侧，OM 可以看作从原点发出的斜率为 k 的射线 y=kx，图中最低可行射线应与阴影三角形刚好相交在右下边界附近。由题干把 M=(x,y) 写成 y=kx 并代入不等式组：2x-kx-2>=0，x+2kx-1>=0，3x+kx-8<=0。即 (2-k)x>=2，(1+2k)x>=1，(3+k)x<=8。由图像和第一式可取相关可行点 x>0；若存在这样的 x，则需要 k<2、k>-1/2，且 x 同时满足 x>=2/(2-k)，x>=1/(1+2k)，x<=8/(3+k)。因此必须有 1/(1+2k)<=8/(3+k)，解得 3+k<=8+16k，即 k>=-1/3；另一条件 2/(2-k)<=8/(3+k) 只给出 k<=1，不限制最小值。取 k=-1/3 时，x=3 可满足全部约束，对应点 (3,-1)。所以最小斜率为 -1/3。

ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the contents of the two attached figures are the same; both are plane rectangular coordinate systems, and the gray shaded region is a triangle, located on the right side of the y-axis, mainly at the position x>0. The three boundary lines are marked in the figure as 2x-y-2=0, x+2y-1=0, and 3x+y-8=0. The origin O is on the left side of the shaded region. In the figure, two dashed lines are drawn from O, among which the lower one points to the lower-right vertex A. Then reason: the problem statement gives that M is in the closed triangular region represented by the system of inequalities 2x-y-2≥0, x+2y-1≥0, 3x+y-8≤0. Find the three vertices: solving 2x-y-2=0 and x+2y-1=0 simultaneously gives (1,0), and at this time the slope of OM is 0; solving 2x-y-2=0 and 3x+y-8=0 simultaneously gives (2,2), and the slope is 2/2=1; solving x+2y-1=0 and 3x+y-8=0 simultaneously gives (3,-1), and the slope is -1/3. Since the entire feasible triangle is on the x>0 side, the minimum value of the slope y/x of the line OM corresponds to the boundary position where the ray rotating from O is tangent to the region, so the vertex slopes can be compared. The smallest among the three is -1/3.
